comment: Clone-detector findings read by hand and judged, so a scoring change can be
checked against a verdict instead of against a count. Each case names two or
more instances of one reported class; a build handles the case correctly when
it reports a TRUE case and does not report a FALSE one.
Cases marked "found_by": "cpd" were sampled from PMD CPD's output rather
than this tool's, so recall is not measured only over what this tool already
finds. Everything else was sampled from a corpus review of this tool.
Line numbers are only valid at the pinned commits in README.md.

cases.label: SwiftUI: rulesSection vs reviewSection
cases.why: Governed-rule annotation against approve/reject. Alike only in being SwiftUI.

cases.label: memberwise inits across 4 unrelated models
cases.why: Genuinely the same structure, unrelated in meaning, and a memberwise init cannot be factored out.

cases.label: whole types: LSPConnection vs MLXBackend
cases.why: An LSP subprocess actor against an MLX inference actor. A large type is a large type.

cases.label: TeamStandard fixture repeated in 3 suites
cases.why: The same nine-line literal character for character; one copy annotated to say it differed.

cases.label: ensureLLMLoaded vs ensureEmbedderLoaded
cases.why: Same cache check, in-flight dedup and failure cleanup; the duplication hid a real concurrency bug.

cases.label: generate7B vs generate14B
cases.why: The same test with a different model — one parameterised test.

cases.label: targetFromPath vs resolveTarget
cases.why: The same path-splitting function written twice in two files, differing only in nil vs "Unknown".

cases.label: fence-scanning loop written twice
cases.why: Same loop, same helpers, differing by < against <= — a near-miss whose difference may be a defect.

cases.label: ordinal-backed Comparable on two enums
cases.why: Boilerplate this corpus has already chosen to remove elsewhere (SourceLocation Comparable).

cases.label: three TypeCollector visitors
cases.why: Identical but for the decl kind visited — one generic collector.

cases.label: whole test suites: InsightQuery vs AntiPatternStore
cases.why: Two entire suites about different subjects. A suite is a suite.

cases.label: SwiftUI: healthSection vs promptSection
cases.why: Health metrics against a prompt text editor. The SwiftUI family, outside a UI-dense repo.

cases.label: chains of .count additions in two test files
cases.why: Both a + chain over member counts, over unrelated collections. Irreducible.

cases.label: row parsers: parseOutcomeRows vs parseBead
cases.why: Both a guard-let chain over [String: Any]; the shared part is optional-binding syntax, not logic.

cases.label: two suppression visitors already sharing a base class
cases.why: Already factored: both override SuppressionVisitorBase at the four points that vary. Nothing left to remove.

cases.label: multi-line source literals used as test fixtures
cases.why: 743 instances of `let source = """..."""` holding different Swift. These are the inputs, not duplication.

cases.label: two enum-mapping visitors share their whole preamble
cases.why: Byte-identical stored properties and visit(EnumDeclSyntax), comments included.

cases.label: finalizeAnalysis duplicated across two idempotency visitors
cases.why: Same upward-inference algorithm — orderedSources, applyBodyInference, the site loop.

cases.label: import blocks repeated across 91 files
cases.why: A run of `import` declarations. 91 instances, the repo's top finding by volume, and nobody deduplicates imports.

cases.label: authenticate vs append: make a value, pass it on
cases.why: Credential auth against multipart body parts. Alike only in constructing one value and handing it on.

cases.label: SwiftUI bodies in third-party code
cases.why: Profile fields against an unread-count button. Both `if #available` + `#if os(visionOS)` + modifiers, sharing nothing else.

cases.label: two whole test files, different subjects
cases.why: 1670 and 1516 lines of unrelated tests. A test file is a test file.

cases.label: three reactive spec files, same tests
cases.why: Observable/Single/SignalProducer specs, identical but for asObservable/asSingle and onNext/onSuccess.

cases.label: same trust test written twice for two evaluators
cases.why: Same function name, same body, DefaultTrustEvaluator against RevocationTrustEvaluator. One parameterised test.

cases.label: validation test scaffolding written twice
cases.why: Identical 29-line session/endpoint/two-expectation setup, differing only in the validate call.

cases.label: toEventually and toEventuallyNot, 32 instances
cases.why: Identical but for .toMatch/.toNotMatch, the description and the fnName. One private helper parameterised by style.

cases.label: expect and expects have identical bodies
cases.why: Byte-identical. The alias should call the original rather than repeat it.

cases.label: the same SQL setup block five times in one file
cases.why: Byte-identical CREATE TABLE / INSERT text repeated across five tests.

cases.label: two extension blocks on one type in one file
cases.why: Path's public API against its internal storage and init. Alike only in being a long extension of Path.

cases.label: an extension block against a free function
cases.why: Polygon's extension against triangulateVertices. 400 lines alike in nothing but size.

cases.label: async continuation bridges
cases.why: Four `withCheckedContinuation { c in callback { c.resume() } }` wrappers. Extracting the wrapper hides which method is bridged.

cases.label: a matrix of record test suites over primary-key kinds
cases.why: Five suites of ~900 lines whose assertions genuinely differ — nil primary key inserts a row in one and throws in another. The variation is the subject.
